description: MainActivity.kt - Defines the MainActivity for an Android Tic Tac Toe app, handling UI setup, user interactions, and observing ViewModel state for game logic display.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android Activity that displays the Tic Tac Toe game UI, manages user interactions, and observes game state via ViewModel.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up event handlers, and renders initial game state.

methods.name: renderBoard
methods.description: Updates the Tic Tac Toe board buttons to reflect the current game state.

methods.name: renderStatus
methods.description: Updates the status TextView to show current player's turn, winner, or draw, with color styling.

methods.name: maybeShowOutcome
methods.description: Displays an alert dialog when the game ends, indicating winner or draw, with options to restart or close.
